# Rubik Buddy support

For help with scanning or using the app, email **[info@freevia.org](mailto:info@freevia.org)**.

## Report a technical bug

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/freevia-org/rubik-buddy/issues) and include:

- App version and Android version.
- Phone model, if the issue concerns the camera or layout.
- Lighting conditions and cube type if a colour was misread.
- Steps to reproduce, what you expected and what happened.

Issues and attachments are public. Do not post photos that show people or private
surroundings; use email for anything you would rather not share publicly.

## Suggest an improvement

Open an issue describing the situation you want to improve and what would help.

See the [privacy policy](../docs/privacy-policy.md) for how data is handled.
